result.detail: No vendor gate. Anyone creates bot via @BotFather and gets token instantly. Client API: any user gets own api_id via "API development tools" form, no review. No user/install cap documented for unreviewed bots/apps. Only limits: one api_id per phone number, sample api_id unusable for released apps, abuse bans. Telegram Bot API docs also list no marketplace/verification requirement.
result.quote: To get started, message @BotFather on Telegram to register your bot and receive its authentication token.
